facts.value: As part of your studies in our Department of Economics, you can complete certain modules in other departments, known as import modules from other departments - including optional modules. This is only possible based on existing cooperation agreements between the departments.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: For the degree programs of the Department of Economics, an overview is provided of which import modules you can register for in other departments and how you can incorporate these import modules into your degree program in the Department of Economics.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: Moreover, you cannot incorporate modules from other departments into your degree program in the Department of Economics and cannot earn different credit points (CP).
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy
